title: typo3-records-list-types: the skill at work
description: Cards, timelines and catalogues through TSconfig. Recorded in this TYPO3 v14 lab: the TSconfig of the Records List Examples package, then the Records module on the news folder. Narrated, with English captions.
alt: Film, 48 seconds: the typo3-records-list-types agent skill. Page TSconfig adds view types to the TYPO3 v14 Records module. Editors switch a news folder from the table to grid, timeline and catalogue views. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: The Records module shows a plain table, even for news with photos.
You ask for cards with thumbnails instead of the table.
The extension adds the views. TSconfig decides which ones each page allows.
Grid, timeline, catalogue: editors switch views, and nothing in core is patched.
Configure, do not patch. Accessibility is evidenced, not assumed.
